name: mcp-cli-starter-template
description: Turborepo starter for MCP+CLI+TUI tools + the programmable scaffolder (`mcp-scaffold`) that generates and retrofits them. Includes robustness harness (watchdog/logger/shutdown), dispatcher invariants, stdio + Streamable HTTP transports, optional Rust acceleration, Mintlify docs, and matrix CI.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo coverage

author: George G
